excerpt: Hi HN, we’re Robert and Din from Laminar. We’ve been building open-source observability for AI agents since 2024. Recently, we released flow-1, a model trained with RL to find errors in agent traces. On our benchmark it matches GPT-6-sol in detection quality while being 23x Flow-1 reads full agent traces and points at the step where the agent went wrong. The authors say it matches GPT-6-sol in detection quality while being 23x cheaper. The observability platform is open source.
